title: Clinical record contract v1 (C5 encounters and authorship, C6 chart, C7 perio, C8 medical history, C9 note templates, C10 notes, C11 treatment plans, C12 estimates, C13 consent, C14 rendered procedures; synthetic data only; recommended-pending-clinical-approval)

AcceptanceRef.description: Opaque plan-version acceptance reference (C12; C13 binds consent to it).

ActorRef.description: Opaque principal reference of a tenant member.

AiRef.description: Opaque model or prompt version reference of an AI-assisted draft (provenance only; nothing generates text here).

stale.description: True when an item of this kind was recorded after the review.

AlertStatus.description: unknown: nothing recorded or reviewed (never "no allergies"); none_reported: a none-known statement is recorded; reviewed_none: a clinician attested none at an encounter and nothing of the kind was recorded since; present: active items exist.

ArtifactDigest.description: SHA-256 of an artifact held elsewhere; never the bytes.

ArtifactRef.description: Reference to an evidence artifact held elsewhere (scan, portal record); no bytes or signature image are stored here.

Assignee.description: A scheduling resource of kind provider (provider roles) or staff (the staff role) at the encounter location.

AssignmentRole.description: Encounter role assignments, each independent of the others and of the author.

AssumptionSourceRef.description: Reference to where a staff-entered assumption came from (a B5 eligibility response later); never a value.

ChartDetailText.description: Free text as recorded; never interpreted.

clinicalAuthor.description: The clinician the finding is attributed to; null for imported and patient-reported entries (the recorder is recordedBy).

ChartEntryCorrect.description: Write a superseding entry for the named entry; unspecified fields carry forward, null clears surfaces or detail text. The prior entry is never changed or deleted.

ChartEntryRecord.description: Record one chart entry (append-only). A duplicate of an active entry (same tooth, surface set, kind, finding and provenance) returns the existing entry.

ChartEntryState.description: State as of the read: superseded when a later correction names this entry.

recorded.description: false: nothing was charted by then (an explicit empty state, not an error).

ChartRecordedState.description: The state stated when the entry was written. entered_in_error only by correction.

ChartRef.description: Opaque chart reference: one per source patient, so merged charts stay distinguishable (C6).

ChartToothState.description: Chart state reconstructed from active entries. A tooth with no active entry is not listed (not charted is not the same as healthy or missing).

ClinicalAuthor.description: Who authored a clinical mutation: the authenticated human and the clinical role configured for them at that instant.

ClinicalAuthorDefine.description: Define (no expectedVersion) or change (with expectedVersion) the clinical author profile of a tenant member. Requires admin.configure.

ClinicalRole.description: Configured clinical role of an author (recommended-pending-clinical-approval).

templateStatus.description: Whether the template digest resolves in the tenant registry now; an unresolved digest is retained and flagged, never cleared.

Consent.description: A treatment consent record (C13). State and withdrawal are as of the read instant (or the asOf of a list).

ConsentScope.description: What the treatment consent covers. Not E's messaging consent.

ConsentSigner.description: Who gives or withdraws consent: the patient, or a related person whose authority is evaluated now through S5 (scope consent).

ConsentSignerRecord.description: The signer authority as evaluated when this fact was recorded (never re-derived later).

ConsentTemplateRef.description: Reference to a consent text held outside this module; versioned by digest.

ContentDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical form of a frozen note version (content, references, author, instant).

CoverageStatus.description: Whether a coverage reference was entered and fresh, absent (unknown) or older than the tolerance (stale). Never an eligibility guarantee.

CredentialRef.description: Reference to a credential held by the staff module; the credential detail is not stored here.

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code; must equal the tenant billing currency (422 currency_mismatch).

Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound, HMAC-protected. Never parse it.

Encounter.description: Encounter (C5). Attendance (S11), procedure completion (C14) and billing (B1) are separate facts and never set here.

EncounterOpen.description: Open an encounter. With an appointment the location is the appointment location; without one, locationRef is required.

Estimate.description: An immutable estimate version (C12). Not a coverage guarantee; coverage is unknown until B5 exists.

EstimateAssumptionInput.description: A coverage or discount assumption recorded by reference with its source freshness; never applied as a value here.

EstimateConsentBinding.description: Whether a C13 consent is bound to the accepted plan version. An acceptance without a bound consent is never consented treatment.

EstimateLineInput.description: A staff-entered per-item fee placeholder for an item that names a fee schedule reference (synthetic; no fee schedule data until B9).

EstimatePresent.description: Present the current estimate; an optional guard naming the estimate number the caller looked at.

EstimateRef.description: Opaque estimate version reference (C12); B consumes estimates by this reference.

FeeScheduleRef.description: Reference to a fee schedule entry owned by billing; no amount is stored here.

recorded.description: False when no history was recorded at signing: unknown, not empty.

HistoryChangeInput.description: A new item (kind, no itemRef) or a change of an existing item (itemRef, no kind). Unspecified text and dates carry forward. On an existing item an omitted field carries forward and null clears it (hardening).

HistoryChangeRecord.description: Record one history version (an append-only change set). Verification is a separate command and cannot be set here.

HistoryDetailText.description: Free-text detail (reaction, dose, notes) as reported.

HistoryEntryType.description: none_known records an explicit "none known" statement for allergy, condition or medication; it is not the same as nothing recorded.

HistoryItem.description: An item as of the read instant: its current change, the verification of that exact change (or null), and every earlier change and verification.

recorded.description: False when nothing was recorded as of the instant: an unknown history, not an empty one.

HistoryState.description: Removal is a state change with a reason, never a delete. discontinued applies to medications only.

HistoryStreamRef.description: Opaque history stream reference: one per source patient (C8).

HistoryText.description: Free text as reported; never interpreted, never checked against a drug database.

HistoryVersionHeader.description: One recorded history version: who reported it, who recorded it, from which source, when.

MinorUnits.description: Signed integer minor units. On journal lines debit is positive and credit negative.

Money.description: SHARED-CONTRACTS Money: explicit currency and integer minor units. Never a float.

procedureSource.description: Encounter procedures (C11 proposed, C14 rendered) do not exist yet; the caller supplies the codes.

procedureCodeRefs.description: Comma-separated synthetic procedure codes proposed or rendered at the encounter (caller-supplied until C11/C14).

enforced.description: C-D4: an enforced template blocks signing (not drafting) until satisfied.

NoteTemplateVersionRef.description: Opaque note template version reference (C9); a signed note pins one.

NoteText.description: Clinical note text as written; never interpreted.

NoteType.description: Note type key (for example progress). Configuration, not a clinical code.

digestVerified.description: The stored digest recomputed on read; false means altered content.

PatientResponsibility.description: C-D7: a labelled unknown or a bounded range; never a guaranteed patient-responsibility figure.

status.description: Only compared sites carry a delta; every other site is listed with the reason, never treated as a change.

PerioCorrectionValue.description: The superseding value: not_measured, or measured with the field the measure takes (mm, present or grade).

PerioDepthSeries.description: Probing depth per site in the scheme order (db, b, mb, dl, l, ml): whole millimetres within provisional engineering bounds 0..20, or not_measured (never zero).

PerioExamCorrect.description: Supersede named current measurements with a reason; the prior values remain.

PerioExamRecord.description: Record one complete exam: every listed tooth with every site of the scheme, each value measured or explicitly not measured. A partial exam is refused as a whole.

PerioFlagSeries.description: Bleeding per site in the scheme order: present true or false, or not_measured.

approvalStatus.description: No formula is clinically approved; a derived value is never presented as approved (C-D3).

historical.description: true when the formula was withdrawn after this derivation.

PerioFormulaRef.description: Synthetic formula identifier in the tenant registry; no clinical meaning (C-D3: every formula pending approval).

PerioGradeValue.description: A grade from the tenant-configured vocabulary, or explicitly not_measured.

PerioRecessionSeries.description: Recession per site in the scheme order: whole millimetres within provisional engineering bounds -10..20, or not_measured.

PerioSiteScheme.description: Provisional six-site scheme (C-S1-Q5: the site definition is a clinical value pending the reviewer).

PerioStreamRef.description: Opaque periodontal stream reference: one per source patient, so merged exams stay distinct (C7).

PerioToothInput.description: One tooth of an exam: tooth-level grades and one value per site of the scheme, in scheme order (exactly six).

PlanAreaCode.description: Provisional area vocabulary (quadrants and arches; pending clinical approval).

PlanItemAdd.description: Add an item to a detail. There is no amount: a fee schedule reference or nothing (estimate-incomplete).

PlanItemRef.description: Opaque plan item reference (C11; C14 renders against it).

PlanItemState.description: Item state; completed is set only by a rendered procedure (C14).

anyOf.description: Recorded by C12 through the acceptance seam; consent (C13) is a separate later fact.

estimateReadiness.description: Whether every item names a fee schedule reference. Never an amount: pricing is C12 and billing.

PlanVersionRef.description: Opaque plan version reference (C11; C12 binds estimates and acceptance to it).

PlanVersionState.description: superseded once a later version names this one; accepted (C12 seam) is immutable content.

ProcedureBillingEvent.description: The C14 -> B contract: identifiers and the correction relationship only; never an amount, narrative or demographic value. patientRef is the encounter patient when the fact was recorded.

ProcedureCodeRefs.description: Provisional synthetic procedure-code references (C-D2); never a licensed code table.

ProcedureCorrect.description: Correct a rendered procedure by a reversal and, optionally, a linked replacement.

ProcedureDuplicateIntent.description: Explicit indicator that a same-looking procedure is intentionally recorded again.

ProcedureRef.description: Opaque rendered-procedure reference (C14); the only key billing (B) uses for a charge.

ProcedureRender.description: Record that a procedure was actually performed in this encounter. A planned procedure names its plan item (code, tooth and surfaces come from it); an unscheduled one names its SYN- code. No amount, no narrative.

ProcedureReplacement.description: The corrected values; anything omitted is carried from the reversed procedure.

ProviderResourceRef.description: A scheduling resource of kind provider (S7): the rendering provider.

ReasonCode.description: Server-checked reason value; never free text (vocabulary pending clinical approval).

chartDiscrepancy.description: The recorded chart entry was later superseded or marked in error; the recorded tooth is kept and flagged for review.

ReportedBy.description: Who reported the information (the recorder is always the authenticated clinical author).

ReviewOutcome.description: none: reviewed with the patient and none present; confirmed: the recorded list was reviewed.

SectionKey.description: Section key of a note template (synthetic placeholder; required sections are C-S2-Q1, blocking).

SourceRef.description: Reference to the source document or import batch; required for imported provenance.

SyntheticCodeRef.description: Provisional internal synthetic code (C-D2). Not a licensed terminology code; carries no clinical meaning.

ToothDisplaySystem.description: Numbering projection of the canonical identity (C-D1: Universal is the US default; FDI per preference).

ToothInput.description: A tooth named in a supported numbering system (Universal, FDI) or by canonical reference. The server resolves the canonical identity; an unknown code is refused, never guessed.

ToothRef.description: Canonical tooth identity (the authority) with numbering projections; null where a system has no counterpart (for example a supernumerary tooth).

ToothSurface.description: Provisional surface vocabulary (C-S1-Q2 pending reviewer); validated per tooth type by the server.

targetRef.description: The plan, version, detail or item the command created or changed.

TreatmentPlanCreate.description: Create a plan and its first (draft) version.

ImageRef.description: Opaque I3 image reference (I owns the image object, bytes, digest, patient association and matching). C stores only a link to it.

ImageLinkCreate.description: Link an I3 imageRef to an encounter. Only a reference: no bytes, digest, modality or match status are accepted.

ImageLinkRelink.description: Move an active link to another encounter of the same patient; the prior link is kept, ended.

ImageLinkUnlink.description: End an active link with a reason; the link stays in history.

ImageResolutionStatus.description: I3's current answer for the imageRef at read time: current (same association as when linked), association_changed (re-associated since; review), unavailable or not_found (review), resolver_unavailable (the seam is not wired).

EncounterImageLink.description: C15 encounter image link: encounter, current encounter patient, opaque imageRef, link history and I3's status at read time. No image metadata is copied.

LabCounterpartyRef.description: The lab as recorded data (a practice-assigned reference; no lab directory or interface exists).

LabCaseNumber.description: The case reference, unique per lab counterparty within the practice.

AttachmentRef.description: Opaque object reference to an attachment I stores; C stores no document bytes.

LabCaseState.description: Provisional proposed state set (C-D9 pending); each state can be disabled per practice configuration.

LabCaseCreate.description: Record a lab case in draft. No electronic order is sent (print/export is the only channel).

LabCaseSetState.description: Record a lab case transition (received is recordReturn; remake is its own command).

LabCaseReturn.description: Record the lab return: a received date and either attachment references or a stated reason.

LabCaseRemake.description: Create a remake case linked to this one; this case ends as remake, its history unchanged.

overdue.description: Derived: expected return date passed while sent or in progress.

LabCase.description: C16 lab case with its full transition history and attachment references (no document bytes).

LabCaseExport.description: The printable lab case package (C-D9: print/export is the only channel; nothing is transmitted).

ReferralCounterpartyRef.description: The other practice or provider as recorded data (no directory or exchange channel exists).

ReferralRecordKind.description: Kinds of clinical record a package may reference.

ReferralCreate.description: Record a referral. An outgoing referral needs the configured disclosure consent; an incoming one records what another practice sent.

ReferralPackage.description: Record the explicit selection of record references for the package (nothing is selected by default).

ReferralShareCreate.description: The explicit share record any cross-practice disclosure needs: purpose, scope (record kinds) and expiry.

ReferralSend.description: Record that the package was handed over by print or export (the only channels; nothing is transmitted).

ReferralResponse.description: Record a response with its source; returned records are object references, never authored by this practice.

ReferralRecall.description: Recall a sent referral: a correction with a reason; the sent fact stays.

attribution.description: Who authored the returned record: never the referring clinician’s signature.

Referral.description: C17 referral record: direction, counterparty, reason and scope, the explicit selection, share records, responses with provenance and the event trail.

ReferralExport.description: The printable referral package under its share record: references only (C-D10; nothing is transmitted).
